ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The knee chart is in the red folder. ... The stomach chart is in the blue folder. ... The heart chart is in the yellow folder. ... What colour is the folder with the chart on the body part that bends the leg?" -> answer org red; the alt prompt asks about the stomach (bridge alt), its 10th statement. Possible answers after the patch: blue (answer of bridge alt's statement), yellow (answer at the same statement slot), grey (the alt prompt's own answer), red (answer org kept).
